title: BUGFIX — TTS ElevenLabs quota_exceeded fallback to local TTS
rationale: ElevenLabs quota exhausted (0/40000 credits) causing TTS failures in scs001-live pipeline. tts-voiceover.ts only falls back to local TTS when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is missing, not when quota is exceeded. Fix: detect quota_exceeded 401 response, set useLocalFallback flag, fall back to generateLocalVoiceover for remaining segments. Local TTS (macOS say) is available and free.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/tts-voiceover.ts: (1) In generateVoice(), after checking !res.ok, add detection for quota_exceeded: if status=401 and body contains quota_exceeded, throw Error('ELEVENLABS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: ...'). (2) In generateVoiceover(), add a useLocalFallback boolean flag after the segments array init. (3) In the segment try/catch, when err.message starts with ELEVENLABS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and isLocalTTSAvailable(), set useLocalFallback=true and return generateLocalVoiceover(bundle, outDir, false). (4) At the start of each segment's try block, if useLocalFallback is true and isLocalTTSAvailable(), also return generateLocalVoiceover to skip ElevenLabs for remaining segments.
